I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the deadline is 20 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and no later message in the channel changes it.

Before reading the channel I confirmed Dana is a member. The gbrain recall found nothing, but it was keyword-only. The date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.

One problem: the channel shows my wrap-up note from Ilse's request, the one explaining what I did, as a separate top-level message from me in #north-team. That note was meant for you, not the channel. It contains nothing sensitive, but it's clutter the team can see. You may want to delete it. I didn't remove it myself, and I don't have a delete tool.
